description: This file implements a Composer ClassLoader class which supports PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap autoloading for PHP. It manages class prefix mappings, directory registrations, and file loading logic for dynamic class inclusion.

classes.name: ClassLoader
classes.description: Implements a versatile autoloader supporting multiple standards (PSR-0, PSR-4) and class map, used by Composer for class file resolution and autoload registration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the classloader with optional vendor directory and setting up include closure.

methods.name: getPrefixes
methods.description: Returns all registered PSR-0 prefixes and their directories.

methods.name: getPrefixesPsr4
methods.description: Returns all registered PSR-4 namespace prefixes and their directories.

methods.name: getFallbackDirs
methods.description: Returns fallback directories for PSR-0.

methods.name: getFallbackDirsPsr4
methods.description: Returns fallback directories for PSR-4.

methods.name: getClassMap
methods.description: Returns class-to-filepath mappings.

methods.name: addClassMap
methods.description: Merges additional class map entries into the existing class map.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds PSR-0 directories for a given prefix, with option to prepend.

methods.name: addPsr4
methods.description: Adds PSR-4 directories for a namespace prefix, with validation and options to prepend.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets PSR-0 directories for a prefix, replacing existing mappings.

methods.name: setPsr4
methods.description: Sets PSR-4 directories for a namespace, replacing existing mappings.

methods.name: setUseIncludePath
methods.description: Enables or disables searching the include path for class files.

methods.name: getUseIncludePath
methods.description: Checks if include path searching is enabled.

methods.name: setClassMapAuthoritative
methods.description: Marks the class map as authoritative, affecting fallback search behavior.

methods.name: isClassMapAuthoritative
methods.description: Returns whether the class map is set as authoritative.

methods.name: setApcuPrefix
methods.description: Sets the APCu cache prefix if APCu extension is enabled and active.

methods.name: getApcuPrefix
methods.description: Returns the current APCu prefix or null if not enabled.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers this ClassLoader instance with PHP's SPL autoload stack, optionally at the beginning.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters this ClassLoader instance from the SPL autoload stack.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class given its name by finding and including the corresponding file.

methods.name: findFile
methods.description: Attempts to locate the filepath corresponding to a class name, utilizing class map, prefixes, fallback dirs, and include path.

methods.name: getRegisteredLoaders
methods.description: Returns all loader instances registered within the static registry.

methods.name: findFileWithExtension
methods.description: Finds the class file with specified extension (.php or .hh), searching through registered prefixes, fallback dirs, and include paths.

methods.name: initializeIncludeClosure
methods.description: Initializes the static closure used to include class files in a scope isolating from $this.
